facts.fact: AGEFAU financed the launch on 1 September 2026 of office-software and collaborative-tools training run by the Centre de Formation des Collectivités Territoriales for 504 elected officials and staff of 126 communes, whose first session drew 84 participants from 21 communes.
facts.system: Centre de Formation des Collectivités Territoriales training

MLI.note: The 200 million FCFA convention funds training; no state budget line for digital programmes or statement on domestic financing.
Training for commune staff is capacity, not an office connection.
